english.title: Induce another to quit UK under misrepresentation as to foreign service
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) induced **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to

(A)_[quit]_
(B)_[embark on a ship within]_

His Majesty’s dominions under a misrepresentation or false representation of the service in which that person was to be engaged, with the intent or in order that such person would accept or agree to accept a commission or engagement in the military or naval service of a foreign state, namely **(..SPECIFY STATE..) at war with a friendly state, namely **(..SPECIFY FRIENDLY STATE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 6 of the Foreign Enlistment Act 1870.

english.notes:
(i) The term of imprisonment to be awarded in respect of any offence against this Act shall not exceed two years.
(ii) Section 10 of the Interpretation Act 1978 states that any reference to the Sovereign reigning at the time of the passing of the Act is to be construed, unless the contrary intention appears, as a reference to the Sovereign for the time being. As such, references to ‘Her Majesty’ and ‘the Queen’ have been replaced in the wording of the offences to state ‘His Majesty’ or ‘the King’, although this may not be the strict wording of the legislation.
